content: Hi Paul. How are you, friend.
Not good. My cousin is driving me up the wall.
He stays up untill all hours of the night, and he never lifts a finger to help.
Have you talk to him about it?
Not yet, but I have to soon. He's eating me out of house and home. I caught him reading the fridge again last night
Hahaha, Maybe that will help you lose weight.
This is no larghing matter, Nick.
Sorry Paul. I couldn't help it. So why doesn't he give you a hand?
He watchs the tob too much. Now really I don't know. But I can't handle this much longer.
Well, talk to him, and let me know what happens, OK?
